plugins.name: unreal-kit
plugins.description: Unreal Engine automation: Python API for asset inspection and data extraction; MCP server for live Editor authoring (actors, Blueprints, materials, PIE)

plugins.name: cache-kit
plugins.description: Cache usage reporting - per-request and session-level cache hit analysis from Claude Code transcripts

plugins.name: bootstrap
plugins.description: Installs each plugin's tools, Python venvs, and config automatically at session start.

plugins.name: p4-kit
plugins.description: Multi-agent code review for pending Perforce changelists (/p4-code-review) -- auto-shelves, reviews, cleans up.

plugins.name: git-kit
plugins.description: Multi-agent pre-push code review for git (/git-code-review) with per-finding validation and declined-findings memory.

plugins.name: skills-kit
plugins.description: Author and audit every md file a project loads or ships -- CLAUDE.md, SKILL.md, project docs, and their cross-references -- for placement, cohesion, and drift.

plugins.name: claude-ui-kit
plugins.description: Claude Code status line with context-window and rate-limit threshold colors, plus the /statusline skill to inspect and customize it.

plugins.name: awesome-kit
plugins.description: Provides plugin-ecosystem, orchestrate, debug-context, verbose-updates, and arewedone skills for plugin browsing, delegated work, answering why-did-you questions from context, progress communication, and auditing whether session work is complete.

plugins.name: llm-scripting-kit
plugins.description: Frozen legacy provider. Use llm-kit for LLM access, credentials, endpoint/model resolution, and completion.

plugins.name: hue-kit
plugins.description: Manage Philips Hue scenes as editable YAML -- bridge sync and dry-run apply.

plugins.name: bootstrap-stuck-fix
plugins.description: TEMPORARY remediation: unwedges a machine stuck on an old bootstrap version -- repairs the malformed duplicate registry record, and updates bootstrap at the scope it is actually installed at. Withdraw once the known user population has run it.

plugins.name: content-pipeline-kit
plugins.description: Frozen legacy provider. Use llm-kit for the batch content pipeline library, skills, agent, and workflow.

plugins.name: secrets-kit
plugins.description: Fleet secrets provisioning: materialize age-encrypted credentials from a private repo onto each machine, declaratively. One passphrase-protected identity per fleet, unlocked once per machine; blobs encrypt to the public key so adding or rotating a secret never needs the passphrase. Session-start convergence + CLI.

plugins.name: workflow-kit
plugins.description: Incremental, native-preserving improvements on the native Workflow tool: a declarative .workflow.yaml compiler plus node strategies (deterministic script + OpenRouter model calls) that run as cheap, context-light nodes via a file-passing contract. Experimental.

plugins.name: pdf-kit
plugins.description: Convert HTML files to PDFs with CSS and JavaScript fidelity via headless Chromium.

plugins.name: job-kit
plugins.description: Frozen legacy provider. Use llm-kit for durable agent jobs, the jobs API, and jobs commands.

plugins.name: task-kit
plugins.description: Provides the task skill (a file-backed task-folder system with a CLI for creating, listing, working, closing, archiving, and moving task folders and task_list references) and the task-kit dashboard, a local browser view over every configured project's tasks that can also run one queued item at a time as an unattended Claude job when llm-kit is available.

plugins.name: presence-kit
plugins.description: Is the user at the keyboard, away, or has the work been handed over, and how should Claude wait, ask and recap in each case? Sits above bootstrap, which provisions the environment, because presence is a policy question bootstrap cannot answer for any session.

plugins.name: llm-kit
plugins.description: LLM access, durable agent jobs and batch content pipelines in one library. Consolidation of llm-scripting-kit, job-kit and content-pipeline-kit.
